rationale: C20 is a direct and material precursor. It orders the Interdepartmental Committee on Internal Security, with Civil Service Commission participation, to investigate the Government employee security program and consider uniform standards, procedures, and central review. The child transmits the resulting committee report and directs the Civil Service Commission to prepare a single general employment-eligibility program while agencies review their security procedures. This is substantially the same administrative project carried into its next drafting stage, with closely shared terminology and cooperation machinery. C12 and C07 have related Civil Service Commission or internal-security structures, but neither matches this direct report-to-implementation sequence as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a report on Federal employee security programs which has been prepared by the Interdepartmental Committee on Internal Security
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the National Security Council, utilizing its Interdepartmental Committee on Internal Security, and with the participation of the Civil Service Commission, to make an investigation of the way this program is being administered
shared_material.explanation: The child expressly acts upon the report generated through the investigation requested in C20.

shared_material.child_excerpt: prepare a plan for a single general program covering eligibility for employment in the Federal service, whether on grounds of loyalty, security, or suitability
shared_material.parent_excerpt: consideration given to whether provision should be made for uniform standards and procedures and for central review of the decisions made in the various departments and agencies
shared_material.explanation: Both directives pursue consolidation and uniformity in federal employee loyalty and security administration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: all Executive departments and agencies are authorized and directed to cooperate fully with the Commission
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am asking each of the departments and agencies concerned to cooperate fully in this study
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the full-cooperation instruction while shifting the recipient of assistance from the study process to the Civil Service Commission's implementation planning.

shared_material.child_excerpt: should reexamine its own program in the light of that report with a view to making sure that adequate procedural safeguards are provided
shared_material.parent_excerpt: protecting the security of the Government without unduly infringing on the rights of individuals
shared_material.explanation: The child's procedural-safeguards review implements C20's paired concern with security and individual rights.
